attributes.additional_details: Call for a Democratic Mandate in the Selection of Our Next Prime MinisterThe people of this country deserve a direct say in who leads our nation. Leadership will not be handed over by default or passed along without public consent. In these challenging times, confidence in our government depends on ensuring that the next Prime Minister is chosen through a majority-backed democratic process.With no sitting Prime Minister to make this decision, responsibility now rests with the Petition Committee.
attributes.background: Call for a Democratic Mandate in the Selection of Our Next Prime Minister.
